correctness.rationale: For every n≥1 the entrance inequalities force an empty or contiguous interval; continuity limits each event to a new left endpoint, new right endpoint, or both. Straight initial and unit corner steps explicitly realize every such labelled history. All singleton-choice directions uniquely fix the initial interval; this proves the exact 2^{s−1_{first singleton}} quotient fiber sizes. The Delannoy generating series yields S_n, and 1–2 compositions yield F_{n+1}. Standalone rational-checker tests passed 5,740 histories n≤10 and 59,708 exhaustive lattice paths n≤6. These finite checks are corroborative; the general assertion is certified by its construction and counting proof, with no assumptions about higher dimensions.

originality.rationale: The newly established result is the exact geometric-to-combinatorial bijection for all monotone paths in a natural one-critical family, its exact simplicial-to-diagram quotient fibers and closed total counts. The numerical Pell, Fibonacci and Delannoy sequences are classical, not claimed as newly discovered. Search and full-text comparisons give best-knowledge originality, not an assertion of universal uniqueness.

value.rationale: The 2026 directed-cubical framework explicitly identifies counting simplicial equivalence classes as a difficult computational objective. This theorem supplies exact counts, constructive representatives, and exact barcode-forgetting fibers for the natural maximally incomparable one-critical vertex family. It quantifies an exponentially growing information gap rather than merely computing a textbook sequence, providing an infinite baseline for enumeration methods and the extended fibered barcode.
